schema.description: A distribution account the tenant sends funds from.

distribution_account_address.description: The account's Stellar address. Absent until the account has been provisioned on the network.

distribution_account_type.description: How the account's secret is stored. Additional accounts are always `DISTRIBUTION_ACCOUNT.STELLAR.DB_VAULT`.

distribution_account_status.description: Status of the underlying Stellar account

status.description: Lifecycle status. `PENDING` accounts have been reserved but not yet funded on the network and cannot send. `ARCHIVED` accounts accept no new disbursements and are never deleted.

is_default.description: Whether this is the tenant's default account. Exactly one account is the default, and it cannot be archived.

archived_at.description: When the account was archived, if it has been

schema.title: DistributionWallet
